description: Known product defects found by tests/api/test_ontology.py. A check fails on problems that are not listed here and on listed problems that no longer occur. Remove items once fixed.

ui-profile-filters.reason: Ontology v5.2.2: the value[x] filter of the TNM M symbol profile references a criteria set without criteria.
items: MII_PR_Onko_TNM_m_Symbol: value[x]: criteria set http://fdpg.mii.cds/CriteriaSet/MII_Onkologie_TNM/mii-vs-onko-tnm-m-symbol is empty

ui-profiles-without-criteria.reason: Ontology v5.2.2: UI profile exists, but no criterion uses it.

criteria-without-english-display.reason: Ontology v5.2.2: criteria without an en-US translation (mostly oncology). Found by sampling the first page per context and terminology.
items: Einwilligung: Anschrift und Vitalstatus Melderegister abfragen, speichern, verarbeiten im acribis-Projekt
MII_Onkologie_Histologiegrading: primär erworbene Melanose ohne zelluläre Atypien
MII_Onkologie_Tumorkonferenz: postoperative Tumorkonferenz (Planung der postoperativen Therapie, z. B. zur Frage adjuvante Therapie)

filters-without-english-display.reason: Ontology v5.2.2: filter definitions without an en-US display, mostly oncology reference attributes (focus, reasonReference) and value[x].

data-selection-code-filters.reason: Ontology v5.2.2: the code filter value sets of these data selection profiles return no concepts in the backend (ICU ISO 11073 value sets, ISiK SNOMED CT value sets, VitalSignDE body weight LOINC). Users get an empty code picker.
